description: This file contains tests for a binary search implementation using the Hypothesis property-based testing library. It defines functions for binary search, checks for list sortedness, and includes multiple test functions to verify invariants related to binary search correctness.

methods.name: binary_search
methods.description: Performs a binary search on a sorted list to find the insertion index for a value, maintaining sorted order.

methods.name: is_sorted
methods.description: Checks if a list is sorted in non-decreasing order.
